rules.checksTitle: Data checks for the outcome analysis
rules.checksSub: Applied in this order; a case's first failed check is its exclusion reason
rules.methodTitle: How expected activity is worked out
rules.methodSub: Agreed on 29 Sep 2026; counted tranche by tranche since 1–3 Oct 2026
rules.method1: The targets come in tranches. Each tranche's follow-up starts the day it opened — or the day the learner's F2F batch ended, if later — plus a buffer ({{first}} days for the first tranche, {{later}} for later ones).
rules.method2: Follow-up to the report date is rounded down to a multiple of {{step}} days (the table runs to {{max}} days).
rules.method3: Expected activity = for each tranche, the adoptions it asked for × the forms each should have generated at that tranche's follow-up (table below), added up.
rules.method4: Activity done ÷ expected gives the percentage; adoption target met is adoptions ÷ targets.
rules.targetsDefault: (default steps — set them in Programme settings)
rules.tableTitle: Forms expected per adoption, by follow-up
rules.tableSub: Cumulative forms one adoption should have generated after N days of follow-up; this report's tranche follow-ups are highlighted
rules.tableDefault: Default table built from the LAP visit schedule — edit it to load the revised sheet
rules.tableSaved: Expected-forms table saved — every project now uses it.
rules.tableNote: Counts are cumulative, so they can only stay the same or rise as the follow-up lengthens. Protein counts apply to ANC adoptions for now; an ANC adoption's baby visits are not yet counted in this table.
rules.caseSub: Used for each learner's own cases, the Growth Monitor and the follow-up flags
rules.case1: In pregnancy: an antenatal and a protein check on the adoption day and every {{every}} days, until the birth — or, if no birth is entered, until the due date (LMP + {{days}} days).
rules.case2: From the baby's adoption (its first contact, whatever its age): growth checks by the table; breastfeeding assessments by the table, only for follow-up before {{bf}} days of age.
rules.case3: Complementary feeding by age — at {{ages}} days. Counselling starts from {{from}} days, but the first assessment is at {{first}}: feeding starts at 180 days and needs 15 days to take hold. A baby adopted after {{first}} days is assessed from the first visit.
rules.case4: Follow-up is counted to the report date, up to {{max}} days of age.
rules.case5: A Staff Nurse's hospital cases expect the ward visits in the Staff Nurse row.

expected.nowSub: Each tranche counted at its own follow-up · targets in force on {{date}}: ANC {{anc}} · PNC <5M {{lt5}} · PNC ≥5M {{ge5}} · Staff Nurse {{nurse}}
expected.noBatches: No training date yet — add the batches in Programme settings.
expected.fuTitle: Days since the tranche opened, less its buffer → rounded down to a multiple of 15
expected.typeTitle: Adoption vs activity, by adoption type
expected.typeSub: % of each type's adoption target met, and % of the activity those adoptions were expected to generate
expected.byGroupSub: Adoption target met against expected activity done — best and lowest marked (groups of 3+ learners)
expected.ownTitle: Within the cases they adopted: how active are learners?
expected.ownSub: Learners with at least one adoption, by the share of their own cases' expected forms they have filed — each case's expectation follows its own follow-up
expected.howTitle: How these figures are worked out
expected.how1: Follow-up, per tranche: days since it opened (or the learner's batch ended, if later), less its buffer — {{first}} days for the first tranche, {{later}} after — rounded down to a multiple of {{step}} (98 days counts as 90).
expected.how2: Expected activity: for each tranche, the adoptions it asked for × the forms each adoption type should have generated at that tranche's follow-up, added up (the table is on Rules & definitions).
expected.how3: Own cases: each case's expected forms from its actual follow-up — antenatal and protein checks every fortnight in pregnancy, growth and breastfeeding by the table from the baby's adoption, complementary feeding from 195 days of age.
expected.byBatchSub: A batch that ended after a tranche opened starts that tranche on its own last training day
expected.sameClock: All {{n}} batches had finished training when tranche 1 opened, so every learner counts the same follow-up.
expected.uptakeTitle: How quickly learners took up each tranche
expected.uptakeSub: Days from the day a tranche opened to each learner's first adoption for it, and to the one that completed it
